eligibility-rules-pre-registered.registration: Rules frozen in this file before any entry was admitted; application is mechanical per entry.
eligibility-rules-pre-registered.a-merged-in-window: PR merged into main during the v1.00.29 campaign window (merged_at within [2026-09-10T07:38:22Z, 2026-09-12T15:52:02Z]).

eligibility-rules-pre-registered.failed-cancelled-runs: None excluded: the seed records zero failed and zero cancelled required runs in the window (every entry has checks.failed = []). No cancelled-then-retried run exists in the seed; had one existed, the RETRIED run's data would be used and the cancellation recorded here.

evidence-sources.cohort-seed: q-w10-cohort-seed.json (machine-readable GitHub API fetch by the coordinator: number/title/merged_at/merge_sha/head_sha/checks/ci_wall_seconds per PR)
